messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
['in order to keep you safe we temporarily freeze access to your account.', 'Our Security department has blocked your account remote service.', "Soon, we'll be adding enhanced online security-and we want you to know what to expect.", 'Halifax is proud to announce to you the new update in the security of our online SSL Servers.', 'Some Standard Bank customers have reported experiencing disconnect or write error issues with online banking.', 'We noticed unusual activity on your account', 'Either your information has been changed or incomplete, as a result your access to use our services has been limited.', "we've temporarily limited what you can do with your account until the issue is resolved.", 'Your shipment is scheduled for delivery tomorrow.', "You've sent a payment for 89.95 GPB to John Austin.", 'We’ll send a confirmation when your items ship.', 'YOUR ACCOUNT HAS BEEN LIMITED !', 'Thank you for providing us with an updated email address, richard@highwayman.com', 'You have an unconfirmed payment on your account.', 'APPLE PURCHASE SUCCESSFULLY PAYMENT CONFIRMATION SPOTIFY PREMIUM']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
